observations.behavior: Adds a new retryable error string and its corresponding test, while retaining the existing 404 retryable error.
observations.posthog_connection: This change expands the set of transient, self-recovering errors recognized by the Intercom warehouse ingestion worker. When a warehouse ingestion attempt fails with a 400 Bad Request due to a stale scroll lock, the worker now treats this as a retryable condition rather than a permanent failure, allowing recovery once the stale lock expires. This prevents false-positive error alert

observations.behavior: Adds a test case asserting that the 400 Bad Request error is recognized as retryable.
observations.code_quote: assert any(key in error_msg for key in retryable_errors)
observations.posthog_connection: This test validates that the warehouse ingestion worker correctly identifies the 400 Bad Request error as a transient, retryable condition, ensuring recovery behavior is not broken by future changes.
